summary: All three round-1 findings resolved with value-based assertions and no hollow tests introduced. F1: spec at lines 65-82 mounts on_start trigger with entryStepId=null, asserts start node has funnel-canvas-node--broken class and a broken-edge marker with data-edge-field='entry' — litmus passes (removing broken-entry logic fails both assertions). F2: spec at lines 84-95 mounts an event-only funnel and asserts [data-node-id='start'] does NOT exist while canvas root and step node are present — negative/positive behavioral pair, no tautology. F3: localization assertion upgraded from negative-prefix-only to include trim().length > 0 and toBe('Перехід у воронку') — strong equality check against resolved uk-locale string; would fail on key fallback or missing translation. Suite grows from 7 to 9 specs; all specs pass litmus (removing the feature logic under test would fail each assertion). No mock-only, empty, or redundant tests introduced. Coverage assessment remains adequate.
